title: identity.rs: Identity/get,changes,set
description:
Implement Identity/get, Identity/changes, Identity/set in src/identity.rs.

## Methods to implement

### Identity/get (RFC 8621 §6.1)
- Fetch Identity objects (sending identities: name, email, replyTo, bcc, textSignature, htmlSignature)
- ids=null returns all identities for the account
- Respects 'properties' filter

### Identity/changes (RFC 8621 §6.2)
- Return created/updated/destroyed identity ids since sinceState

### Identity/set (RFC 8621 §6.3)
- create: user-defined sending identity — name, email must be provided
- update: patch any mutable field
- destroy: remove identity (cannot destroy server-set default identity — forbidden error)
- isDefault field is read-only (server-set)

## Key notes
- Identities are per-account, not global
- The server may pre-populate default identities (e.g. from account email address)
- MemoryBackend: pre-populate one default identity on first account access

## Source references
- Stalwart (AGPL — read, do not copy): ~/GIT/stalwart-jmap-server/main/crates/jmap/src/identity/
- RFC 8621 §6

## Test vectors
- Identity/get on fresh account → returns at least one default identity
- Identity/set create → Identity/get returns it
- Identity/set destroy default identity → forbidden error
